text:
Maya: Quick sync  We need a single GA acceptance checklist item that explicitly covers: SLA numeric table, what metrics show in Console, monitoring alert thresholds + runbook links, and any pricing caveats (burst vs reserved). Who owns each?
Diego: I'll coordinate sign-off. High-level ask: deliver a 1-pager + owners for each row. Keep the wording customer-facing (non-legal).
Lina: I'll own monitoring. My proposal: surface per-route 95th and error% for Silver/Gold, aggregate only for Bronze. Alerting: page when route 95th > target for 2 consecutive 3m windows OR error_rate > 0.5% for 10m. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/sre/ga-runbook.
Priya: Docs will own Console copy and screenshots. I'll prepare the "How to read your SLA" card and a "What we show in Console" table. Need exact SLO numbers and any phrasing for "best-effort" vs "guaranteed" from Product.
Aj: Eng notes: per-route telemetry for private installs will be behind a feature toggle (privacy/perf). We'll call the toggle "Route-level metrics" and default to off for Private by GA. PR incoming. Also we should expose a per-customer toggle for auto-fallback behavior.
Frank: Billing note: Reserved (Dedicated) customers get a 10% unit discount + throughput guarantees. Hosted/burst customers are best-effort; overage billed at standard overage rate and may be throttled when sustained above quota. I'll publish a billing footnote and a short "what to expect" snippet for invoices.
Maya: Product decision: Gold SLA (tightest numbers) = Dedicated/Reserved only. Silver = hosted with soft guarantees. Bronze = best-effort. Priya, word the table like that.
Diego: On credits: we need a simple formula for SLA breaches. Suggest: credit = (minutes_outage / minutes_in_billing_period) * monthly_charge * SLA_multiplier. Draft will include an example. Finance must OK.
billing-bot: Billing policy summary: Reserved customers eligible for throughput SLA and discount. Burst customers: overage billed; sustained >10% above quota for 24h may be throttled. See https://billing.redwood/policies.
Lina: Monitoring snippet (PromQL-ish) I'll add to runbook:

# example alert rule
alert: route_slo_violation
expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])[15m:5m]) by (route) > ROUTE_THRESHOLD
for: 6m

Also recommend a global synthetic probe hitting common endpoints every 5m per-region and a canary job that runs for 72h pre-GA.
Aj: Implementation tasks: 1) PR for route-level metrics feature flag (48h). 2) API to set fallback_to_variant per-customer (48h). I'll attach screenshots of Console toggles to the docs PR once merged.
Priya: Docs action items: 1) SLA 1-pager + sample invoice text (36h). 2) Console screenshots for Silver/Gold metrics (mockups now, real after PR). I'll include an FAQ: "When will I see per-route metrics?" and "What does \"best-effort\" mean?"
Maya: Runbook and oncall: primary oncall = eng-platform; escalate to eng-sre if sustained >15m. Who's drafting the escalation steps? Lina?
Lina: Yes, I'll add escalation matrix + playbook snippets. Also I'll include a muted-window policy for deploys (automated mute windows).
Diego: Do we want an automatic fallback to lower-quality model variant on high errors? Product leaning = yes but opt-in per customer. Needs clear doc language and a control in Console.
Aj: We'll implement fallback as a per-deployment policy with default off. We'll also add telemetry tags when fallback engages so billing/credits and analytics can filter those requests.
Frank: For pricing page: I'll add a small table: Reserved = discount + guaranteed throughput; Burst = publish overage rate + best-effort. Also add a "Known limits" box for burst (no throughput guarantee).
Maya: Final action list with ETAs: Lina -> runbook + alerts + escalation (24h). Priya -> SLA 1-pager + Console mockups + FAQ (36h). Aj -> telemetry feature flag PR + fallback policy API + screenshots (48h). Frank -> billing footnote + sample invoice text + credit calc input for Finance (24h). Diego -> consolidate 1-pager and circulate (after all items).
release-bot: Planned maintenance window for GA config push: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC.
Maya: Let's also run pre-GA canary for 72h starting 2026-04-05 to validate SLOs. Lina will post results here. If any owner can't hit ETA, flag now. :pray:
